finding: Runbook Sentinel deliberately permits HTTP binding only to 127.0.0.1, localhost, or ::1. Docker host-port publication forwards to the container interface rather than the container-local loopback listener, so the frozen dedicated-network plus loopback-host-publication plan cannot reach the API.

excluded_remediations.option: Permit 0.0.0.0 or the container interface in create_server
excluded_remediations.reason: Would change the API security boundary and violate BASELINE-0027's behavior-and-authority freeze.
Would violate the frozen no-host-namespace boundary and provide broader network reach than required.

excluded_remediations.option: Install or add a network proxy
excluded_remediations.reason: Would add a dependency or package installation and expand the attack surface.

selected_recovery: Run the API container with --network none, use docker exec to invoke the actual authenticated HTTP surface through its own loopback namespace, extract the exact returned dashboard HTML, and render those bytes on the host. This preserves the existing API binding and adds no network, dependency, secret, or authority.
